program.name: Flexibility 35
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of stretching: legs and hips, or upper body and spine.
program.about: Stretching for about half an hour. One day holds the hamstrings, quads and hips; the other the shoulders, chest and spine. Each opens with a short flow. They alternate. Both later levels hold every stretch longer.
program.split: Legs & hips / upper body & spine, 35 minutes
